summary: PR #1 merged and deployed (CI+CD green): core-shell passes owner 'platform', reports passes owner 'insights' (from package.json team) to validateApp. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build, so there is no registry dependency to bump; passing owner against the old contract is harmless, so I did not wait for dev-a's PR #2. Combined subtasks 3 and 4 in one PR.

PLAT-103-1/2 shipped in PR #2 (merged, CI+CD green). validateApp throws if owner missing/empty/blank; shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0 (breaking; it's an in-repo lib inlined at build, so nothing is published). Billing passes owner 'payments' (from package.json team). Assumptions: combined 1+2 in one PR for ordering; billing has no registry-lib change to adopt (contract is inlined). Note: core-shell and reports (dev-b) must pass owner before their next deploy or they will fail at startup.
